name: Abandoned Subway
voice: Drow: Keep our world a secret. Please take my party theme tape to the vampire DJ.

name: Forest Campsite
voice: Wolfwoman: Humans must never learn about us. There is honey, rosin and flowers to deliver.

name: Mead Cellar
voice: Bear: Too warm to sleep. Damp labels, spoiled mead... I need autumn honey and fresh supplies.

name: Abandoned Radio Tower
voice: Vampire: Tonight I play the host! If only this overheated radio would cooperate.

name: Museum Ruins
voice: Zombie: I repair antiques. Flowers for cakes. Moisture repellent for me. Please.

name: Settlement Bar
voice: Witch: The human parade is outside. Keep the Silence Pact, and bring the party supplies inside.
